decisions.reason: The citrus crate builds directly on the firm's agricultural crate and moulding know-how, so it can learn from harvest feedback, though its absence from the website in 2020-2021 raises some doubt about how visible it still is.
Foldable large containers are a core competence for automotive and industrial customers, and the firm's engineering depth lets it keep refining the line.
Stackable crates sit at the centre of the firm's existing knowledge base and serve food and retail customers steadily, so there is little reason to withdraw them.
The medium-duty rackable pallet extends established pallet engineering, so the firm can interpret demand from pooling and industrial customers and adjust the line in-house.
The spill-retention pallet is a niche safety product with uncertain visibility, but related moulding know-how keeps the cost of maintaining it low.
This modest variant of existing pallets is easy for the firm to assimilate and adjust, though its unobserved status suggests it could be merged into the broader pallet range.
